subject: computer-science
title: Computational Thinking: From Plan to Code
welcome_lead: Turn your plan into pseudocode, then into real Python.
meta_desc: KS3 computational thinking: pseudocode, refinement, testing.
final_note: Plan in plain English first — coding is just translation.

concepts.def: A precise step-by-step method for solving a problem.
Ways to express an algorithm before coding.
Linear search (any list) and binary search (sorted list).
Ordering data, e.g. bubble, merge and insertion sort.
Breaking a problem into smaller parts.
Hiding unnecessary detail to focus on what matters.

walkthroughs.body_html: Pseudocode is structured English: ASK for age. IF age >= 18 THEN PRINT 'adult' ELSE PRINT 'child'. Easy to share and easy to turn into Python.
Start broad: play game. Refine: show menu, get choice, run game, show score. Keep refining until each step matches one line of code.
Run with normal, edge and silly inputs. Add comments so future-you understands your own code.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between an IP address and a MAC address?
options: O(log n).
MAC is a hardware identifier (fixed); IP is a logical network address (assignable).
IP is for input, MAC is for output.
